minutes.headline: Planning Board heard the high school/middle school site plan review and will consider conditional acceptance June 23.
minutes.summary: The board heard the design team and its peer-review engineer walk through a 100-point review of the new high school/middle school site plan, including stormwater, sight distance, and the lot and frontage question for the TC Passios building. It accepted the Elmwood Road Form H covenant, received an ANR plan on Northfield Road, and assigned capital planning and MJTC representatives. Conditional acceptance of the school plan was set for the June 23 agenda, with July as fallback.

what_happened.line: The board heard the design team and peer-review engineer walk through the high school/middle school site plan, covering stormwater, sight distance and lot frontage.
The site plan was placed on the June 23 agenda for possible conditional acceptance, with July as the fallback.
The board voted to accept the Form H covenant for the Elmwood Road subdivision.
The board voted to name representatives to capital planning and to MJTC.
The board will decide June 23 whether to send a letter on the right of first refusal for 145 Page Street.

why_it_matters: The school site plan determines how the new building, its driveway and stormwater are handled, and a public-road driveway would fall entirely on the town budget, mostly taxes, with no MSBA share.
Reusing the TC Passios building and the 145 Page Street first-refusal decision could each affect what the town spends from the town budget, mostly taxes.
